FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TechGuard Solutions specializes in providing comprehensive IT services, including remote technical support, cybersecurity consulting, and software development for small to medium-sized enterprises. Our operations are designed to ensure minimal on-site exposure and focus on secure data management, aligning with industry best practices for data protection and compliance. We offer managed services for network monitoring and cloud management, and our team of certified professionals is dedicated to delivering high-quality solutions tailored to our clients’ needs. We prioritize maintaining robust data handling protocols and adhere to all relevant regulations to safeguard our clients against potential cyber threats.
